english.title: Landlord of dwelling subject to domestic tenancy carry out property management activity without licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the landlord of a dwelling subject to a domestic tenancy, namely **(..SPECIFY DWELLING..), unlawfully

(A)_[collected rent]_
(B)_[were the principal point of contact for the tenant in relation to matters arising under the tenancy]_
(C)_[made arrangements with a person to carry out repairs or maintenance]_
(D)_[made arrangements with a tenant or occupier of the dwelling to secure access to the dwelling]_
(E)_[checked the contents or condition of the dwelling, or arranged for them to be checked]_
(F)_[served notice to terminate a tenancy]_

when not licensed to do so under Part 1 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7(1) and (5) of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.
